title: CheckoutSummary
description: What the checkout page shows before the order is placed. Read aloud and read back (total, delivery PIN) before the user confirms placing the order (rule 2). Personal data is a placeholder; the extension maps it back locally.

id.description: Placeholder id; used as a grounding subject_id.

price.description: The line's price as the page shows it.

total.description: The order total the page shows (what the user will pay). Required to place an order.

delivery_pin_code.description: Delivery PIN code as shown (not a secret; read back before placing).

delivery_address.description: Placeholder (ADDR_n), never the real address; the extension reads it aloud itself.

payment_method.title: CheckoutPayment
payment_method.description: The payment method the page shows as selected.

place_order_target_id.description: ActionTarget id of the 'Place order' button.

missing.description: Fields the page doesn't show, e.g. delivery_charge.
